scope: Official context sources for a drug-repurposing explainer, type 2 diabetes and fluconazole foundation guides, and mechanism glossary definitions.

queries: site.fda.gov understanding unapproved use approved drugs off label
official definitions for hedgehog signaling, apoptosis, autophagy, biofilm, Candida albicans, hyphae, angiogenesis, hypoxia, mTOR, PDE5, ergosterol, cholesterol transport

schema.output: {sources: Source[], guides: Guide[], glossary: Term[]}; types from lib/content.ts
schema.mechanismFields: original action and condition-specific hypotheses separated; sourceId, tier=CONTEXT, exact section locator, target/action, tested versus proposed basis, model/species/exposure if provided, uncertainty and translation limits. No invented primary experiment or clinical synthesis.
schema.researchReviewRule: New papers require substantive Q01-Q15 reviews and source-located extraction before use. This bounded packet uses official definitions, labels and agency explanation pages instead of scholarly reviews or primary papers.

checks.check: Exact output paths and source scope fixed before acquisition
Existing glossary checked; no overlapping mechanism definitions
Entity IDs C31 and D34 absent from current guide registry
Schema preserves source-dependent sentences, locators and context tier
No mechanism-to-efficacy inference or fabricated dosing/outcome table
No new research paper ingestion without complete review

limitations: This context packet does not replace drug-condition mechanistic primary-study review.
Authoritative sources will be opened and verified before drafting their claims.
